Hi {!Core_Inquiry__c.OwnerFirstName}, You are receiving this alert because this person has requested access to the Resource and Design Center and needs CNDA verification/creation. Please take a look at the details below and reach out within three business days to enable access (if applicable).
Click here to see this person’s full profile in Salesforce CRM »
Here are the person’s details: First Name: {!Core_Inquiry__c.Core_First_Name_Txt__c} Last Name: {!Core_Inquiry__c.Core_Last_Name_Txt__c} Company:{!Core_Inquiry__c.Core_AccountName__c} Job Title: {!Core_Inquiry__c.Core_Title_Txt__c} Phone Number: {!Core_Inquiry__c.Core_Phone_Txt__c} Email: {!Core_Inquiry__c.Core_Email_Txt__c} How they found us originally: {!Core_Inquiry__c.Core_Contact_Lead_Source__c} Some details about their Inquiry: Area of Interest: {!Core_Inquiry__c.Core_Product_Interest_Txt__c} Purchase Timeframe: {!Core_Inquiry__c.Core_Project_Timeframe__c} Project Details: {!Core_Inquiry__c.Core_Inquiry_Notes_Txt__c} Please remember to log any calls or emails you make when engaging with this person. If you have questions regarding how to manage any Lead/Inquiry assigned to you, please visit our Sales CRM training website Sincerely, Your Marketing Automation Team
